scoring: Equal-cell mean of dB ratio-of-sums channelNMSE. Learned groups average three fit scores, never predictions. Group p95/p99 are averages of the per-fit case-NMSE quantiles.
primary: high_snr (SNR>20), two gains vs original. Ordinary range and all-range summaries are descriptive.

bootstrap.unit: Whole-anchor case index, shared across all SNR/reference within each regime and paired methods/fits
bootstrap.scope: Conditional on frozen checkpoints, policy selection and listed condition grid; not training-population or policy-selection uncertainty
bootstrap.multiplicity: Two high-SNR aggregate contrasts have Bonferroni simultaneous95 intervals. Per-cell intervals are pointwise95 and negative-cell flags are diagnostic, not familywise claims.
